info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of waitlist information for education enrollments, allowing users to check the status of prospective students waiting for enrollment opportunities. It serves educational institutions and administrators needing insights into waitlisted candidates and their potential impact on course capacity. By accessing this data, users can optimize enrollment strategies and communicate effectively with applicants regarding their status. Typical consumers of this API include enrollment officers, administrative staff, and educational planners looking to enhance student management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of enrollments currently on the waitlist.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all enrollments that are currently on the waitlist. It returns relevant details to understand the status and information of each enrollment waiting for approval or processing.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the waitlist of enrollments. This body contains necessary parameters to specify the desired information regarding waitlisted enrollments.
